missingSeam: The ordinary public FieldLogSignedTask.open overload hardcodes nil commit facts. The only existing facts overload is the entry-commit fixture. The ordinary SignedChecklist route attaches the selected saved draft only.

Using the fixture-style nondeferred binding with the ordinary identity fails deferred_guest_ui_startup. Keeping deferred startup and adding commit facts admits the signed material, but InstalledApplicationStorageAdapter blocks the ordinary selected-draft hydration read when commitArguments is present. The exact guest startup never displays a frame in that combination.

An ordinary owner integration needs a trusted, navigation-scoped reorder attachment and a supported way to hydrate it. One option is an explicitly read-only selected-draft hydration admission separate from the reorder facts/put path. A separately installed nondeferred reorder profile would also need its own approved owner binding and compatible signed guest. The same-turn permit must be consumed within the typed revision-checked repository transaction.
